instruction: Candid action medium shot in an indoor judo dojo. On the left, the young male judoka in a white gi (R2) executes a throw on the older male judoka in a white gi (R3) on the right. The young judoka grips the older judoka's sleeve, pulling him forward, while the older judoka maintains a focused, defensive posture. Bright indoor light illuminates the pair against a background of blue mats and windows.
